name: FreeDuel_UpdateSparkle
notes: Exact overlay match with gcc_2_8_1_g0_split. Scans the sixteen entries of gFreeDuel_apSparklePool from 15 down to 0; an entry whose low nibble at +0x6C is 1 gets bit 0x80 set once and is then initialised with timer 16 at +0x60 colour 0x404040 as a word at +0xC and flag 0x50000000 or-ed into +0x4. Every frame the three colour bytes at +0xE +0xD +0xC fade by 4 and the timer counts down; at zero it calls func_8004036C and clears the slot. Two levers: the decremented timer goes into a named s16 local because reading obj->timer again for the test reloads it and costs an instruction and the sll 16 test comes from the local being signed; and the timer statement is written after the three colour stores. The transposition recorded here as a scheduler choice was that second point: swapping the two adjacent statements is byte-identical because it changes no dependence but moving one past the stores does.
